paper.title: School start times and teenage sleep

paper_text:
School start times and teenage sleep
Garcia, M. (University of Northfield), Okafor, T.  J. Fake Education, 2021

Abstract
Delaying school start by 45 minutes added 31 minutes of sleep per night in 600 students.

Results
Sleep was measured by wrist actigraphy over four weeks (Table 1).

alerts.description: A correction notice was published for this paper.

notice.text:
Correction to: School start times and teenage sleep

The affiliation of the first author was given as University of Northfield. The correct affiliation is Northfield Institute of Education. This does not affect the results or conclusions of the article.
